tasks.analysis: The piano has a rich history that spans over 300 years, evolving from earlier keyboard instruments like the clavichord and harpsichord. The modern piano was invented around 1700 by Bartolomeo Cristofori, who developed a new mechanism that made it possible for players to control the dynamics-soft and loud sounds-by varying the pressure on the keys. Later key improvements include the addition of a cast iron frame and felt-covered hammers, which allowed for greater volume and durability.
